WAITING branch precedes A/B scanning. Native assertion on non-null candidate is conditional on assertions enabled; no fallback candidate.

Mode exactly A gates RE11; true discards candidate, enters SCANNING, sets exact-RED anchor with candidate_invalidation origin or null, continues. Does not emit Reset, reset confirmed/peak or restart leg floor/context.
Strict stored Low improvement precedes high breakout check; update bottom then source index then display. Equality retains old provenance; no numeric conversion here.
Strict stored High>frozen top confirms, equality does not. Write Break index then display before invoking RE10 with mutated Candidate; exceptions propagate, no local rollback.

Shallow replacement creates distinct accepted Candidate before append to local reactions; subsequent pending candidate reference is not this record.

Only full scan: set confirmed bottom/First from copied accepted record, seed peak from full current High and index, mode B SCANNING, clear candidate before post-reset query.
Invoke RE13 even for null analysis; supply new confirmed box bottom, not independently selected exact analysis extreme. Native helper handles null.
Non-null returned lower row emits exact reset: current main index/display, hit display_time (not timestamp attribute), new confirmed level/First. Confirmed reaction remains appended.

No post-break hit and RED main creates a different Mode B candidate on same Break using current main identity/display for First and both source fields; top seeded running High and bottom full current Low. No requirement for non-null analysis or nonempty full lower window. Set WAITING.
Unconditional continue on every WAITING route not exited earlier; never reaches current main A/B scan or peak update.
Only outside WAITING and mode exactly A; on just_started freeze floor current Low, clear flag, take/reset context before color/admission. No anchor reset in this initial assignment.
Only RED can start/reset-adjacent A here; non-null previous reset, exact GREEN tag and inclusive current Low>=reset Low tested in order before RE09 peak query at candle.index.
Select preceding contiguous GREEN peak/source when >= current High including ties; else current High/candle.
Construct candidate A using current First/bottom/source and selected top/source display, frozen floor; optional anchor fields not supplied, default null. Enter WAITING.
If first main is RED but reset-adjacent guard false, set anchor current and origin leg_open. Non-RED leaves existing anchor/origin unchanged. All new-leg paths consume main.
Later A reads prior sequence position index-1, not candle.index-1; no clamp. Reset passes false and nullable top/source for every iteration.

Require previous exact GREEN then current exact RED. Inside this pair, clear anchor and origin only if non-null, origin candidate_invalidation, previous Low < anchor Low and current Low < anchor Low in short-circuit order. Equality at either comparison preserves anchor.

When anchor remains, only inclusive current Low>=anchor Low controls admission; failed anchor has no floor fallback. Only absent anchor permits previous Low OR frozen floor, evaluated in order; floor may be null for incoherent externally restored state and native comparison then fails.
Only passes true computes contiguous GREEN-run peak at candle.index and chooses GREEN owner on equality, else current owner.
On passes, assert top non-null then source non-null when assertions enabled; zero is a valid price, not absence.
Construct A with current First/bottom, selected top/source, optional anchor index and Low selected by truthiness of anchor object (distinct from earlier identity check), frozen floor. Enter WAITING.

If no pass and exact RED, set current scan anchor/origin. Else explicit DOJI or NEUTRAL tag clears both; other tags preserve. Market equality doji classification is separately GREEN, not this legacy tag route.

Non-A scanning enters B-style route. RED starts top at current High/index; non-null running peak >= top overrides with prior peak/source including equality, no independent source-index null validation.

If top source index earlier than candle.index, bottom start source+1, otherwise current stored index. Inclusive minimum_low through current stored index; relies on native position/index alignment and RE07 tie/route contract.
Construct Mode B using current First, chosen top and top display via indexed candle sequence, minimum price and source's stored identity/display. Set WAITING only after construction.

After possible candidate creation, even non-RED updates peak only on null initialization or strict higher current High. Equality retains existing source. Prior WAITING branch consumes its main and never reaches this update. Rechecks historical B02-02-F01 correction.

Normal exhaustion plus retain_initial saves new _InitialLegCursor with next=end+1, state/floor/flag/anchor/origin and pending candidate reference, no copy at save; no confirmed owner/peak/reset context. Early first_only return bypasses retention.
Normal result literal bullish, original detector window, confirmed reaction/reset lists only; pending candidate available only through retained cursor, no finalization of unfinished candidate.
Internal role adapter declaration and docstring; no market reclassification or mutation. Native chart doji stays GREEN.
Create new Candle with same stored index, timestamp, display. Swap only exact GREEN/RED roles using mapping lookup and default stored tag; unknown tags unchanged. No sorting.

Use Decimal copy_negate in order Open, original Low to reflected High, original High to reflected Low, Close; exact sign copy, not context-rounded arithmetic. New Candle object even when fields identical; exceptions propagate.
Null Candidate returns null. Nullable annotation not price arithmetic. Non-null candidate proceeds without validation.
Shallow dataclass replacement evaluates reflected bottom-to-top and top-to-bottom values then swaps paired source indices/displays; no mutation of original or reordering.

Only non-null anchor and floor price sign-copied; zero included. All unlisted fields retain values/references, including mode, First/Break, intrabar start, cross-direction flags, order gate decision and behavior_public_* geometry/time/number/internal metadata; no extra reflection.
Return distinct replaced Candidate; no deep copy or separate publication normalization.

Construct new IntrabarAnalysis after mirroring event Candle, sign-copying extreme, mirroring source Candle in left-to-right order. Even if original event and source refer to same object, calls create separate records; stored index/time preserved; not physical object identity equality.

Candidate invalidation path clears candidate, changes state, updates anchor/origin, consumes main without resetting other leg registers or emitting Reset.

Strict low update before high confirmation; set Break fields before exact analysis. If current main owns bottom and analysis exists, replace price and source unconditionally from analysis, without another strict-improvement test.

Append separate confirmed copy before first_only branch. Early return leaves _initial_cursor null and bypasses remainder processing. Otherwise set confirmed registers, mode B and clear candidate before post-break search.

Exact post-break Reset records hit's display time and owning main identity; clears state and consumes main. Otherwise RED Break seeds new candidate using full main High/Low even if analysis absent. No second pass on same main and no unified full-lower-window requirement.

First main of A leg freezes floor then clears just_started and consumes reset_context. Non-RED does not clear existing anchor here. RED eligible reset route creates A without optional anchor fields; else records leg_open anchor. Always continue.

Later-A passes false per main; prior/current tags before anchor logic. Invalidation-origin anchor clears only on both strict lows; if anchor remains, failed anchor gate has no alternate floor fallback. Absent anchor tests prior then floor; GREEN tie wins top.

Candidate formation preserves source/display fields, optional anchor selected by truthiness, floor frozen. On failure exact RED updates scan anchor; explicit DOJI/NEUTRAL tags clear; other tags preserve. Native price-equality doji remains GREEN.

B selects earlier running peak on equality and computes bottom after earlier top source through current inclusive. Peak update occurs after candidate construction and also on non-RED; initializes null or strictly improves. WAITING branch never reaches this scan update.

Retained cursor only at loop exhaustion; stores candidate reference (restore copies) and no confirmed history or peak. Return only confirmed lists, not pending candidate. first_only return bypasses cursor retention.
Native market doji GREEN is not reclassified. Reflection swaps roles and high/low, preserves index, exact timestamp and display; sign-copy operations preserve Decimal representation semantics.
